summary: Minimal authorized read-only post-session HR summary implemented on the existing React/Elysia/Bun/PostgreSQL/WS stack with additive HR role migration and session-scoped HR grants. Real DB-backed aggregates show per-question n, joined base, unanswered and coverage for any positive n (no five-person gate), n=0 as an empty state without a mean, rating/poll distributions, comment presence count only, deterministic feedback-confidence/blocker text and self-report/small-sample caveats. HR is read-only with a full role/session/expiry/revoke matrix and no raw names/comments/ranking. Native 121/0; Mode B Docker-only 121 tests/0 fail/9 declared skips; typecheck and both builds 0; a fresh owned 30-participant real API/WS/DB smoke reconciled exactly (732 ms observed). Real browser/Safari journey NOT RUN.
user_decision: No minimum-five suppression: show aggregates for any positive n, always with per-question n and joined denominator; n=0 is empty, not a zero mean; synthetic demo only.
